# Glossary

Glossary. Authorization: reserving funds on a card ([[payments-service]]). Settlement: capturing authorized funds, feeding [[billing-service]]. Projection: a read model rebuilt from events ([[ledger-service]]). Canary: a partial rollout on [[kubernetes-platform]]. Consumer lag: messages not yet processed on [[kafka-bus]].
